callouts.title: 命题1
callouts.body: 如果我们对$S_n$的渐近展开的精度要求为$O(g(n))$,而此时恰好有另一个已知渐近展开结果，且精度也为$O(g(n))$的和$S'_n$，同时$$S_n-S_n'=O(g(n))$$那么$S_n,S_n'$的渐近展开在$O(g(n))$的精度下是相同的。

classification_result.id: 一个竞赛中的和的渐近展开问题#2

if_problem.statement_en:
If the required accuracy of the asymptotic expansion of $S_n$ is $O(g(n))$, and there is another known asymptotic expansion for a sum $S'_n$ with the same accuracy $O(g(n))$, and moreover
$$S_n-S_n'=O(g(n)),$$
then the asymptotic expansions of $S_n$ and $S'_n$ are the same up to accuracy $O(g(n))$.

callouts.id: 一个竞赛中的和的渐近展开问题#3
callouts.title: 想法
callouts.body: 命题1告诉我们，如果你发现一个$S_n'$其形式比$S_n$更好得到渐近展开，比如说对$S_n$做某种放缩，只要放缩整体的误差是被$O(g(n))$控制起来的，那么最终的渐近展开是相同的。

classification_result.id: 一个竞赛中的和的渐近展开问题#3

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Replace by a Simpler Comparable Sum
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Use Proposition 1 to replace a difficult sum $S_n$ by a simpler sum $S'_n$ whose asymptotic expansion is easier to compute. If the total error of the comparison is controlled by $O(g(n))$, then both sums have the same asymptotic expansion at that level of accuracy.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Apply this when a target sum is hard to expand directly, but can be bounded or approximated by a structurally simpler sum with a controllable error term of the required order.
